summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, resolve subsequent PR review comments, fix Grafana dashboard provisioning errors and Tauri desktop signing key issues in the staging deployment pipeline, then close out the current milestone by cleaning up worktrees and archiving a stale debug session.
summary.outcome: Recovery E2E test fixed and merged (PR #369) with protobuf field number bug fix and resolution order swap; Grafana API key and Tauri signing keys wired into CI; worktrees cleaned up; stale debug session resolved; docs branch created for milestone completion prep.

repo: IPNS record protobuf field layout: value is field 1, signatureV1 is field 2 — extractCidFromIpnsRecord was incorrectly reading field 2
mock-ipns-routing is used in CI for IPNS resolution; Kubo cannot resolve IPNS names published via mock-ipns-routing, so delegated routing must be tried first
Grafana Cloud /api/health returns 404 (not 401/403) when an API key is invalid or the service account token has expired
TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY is required by tauri-action whenever a pubkey is present in tauri.conf.json — all three desktop build jobs (macOS, Windows, Linux) need it
Grafana data source keys (Loki, Prometheus) are separate from the Grafana instance service account token used for dashboard provisioning via the HTTP API
Worktrees from prior phase branches (e.g., cipher-box-phase-20) can become stale after merges and need periodic cleanup

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord was checking fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) instead of fieldNumber === 1 (value) when parsing the IPNS protobuf record
Vault key blob resolution was trying direct IPFS gateway /ipns/ path (30s timeout) before delegated routing — swapped to try resolveIpns() first
fetchWithRetry backoff only triggered on thrown errors, not non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx) — fixed by adding !resp.ok check before the retry sleep
resp.json() consumed the response body, making the fallthrough resp.arrayBuffer() call fail — fixed by wrapping protobuf parse in an else branch
Added shared RECOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS constant to sync test timeout (90s) with assertion timeout, preventing assertion timeout firing before test timeout
All three tauri-action jobs (macOS, Windows, Linux) were missing TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD env vars despite the pubkey being present in tauri.conf.json

workflow: When a CI job fails with SSH i/o timeout, always verify VPS reachability before assuming a code issue — transient network blips between GitHub Actions runners and the VPS are common
Grafana Cloud service account tokens should be stored as repo secrets (not environment secrets) so all environments can access them
Before dismissing a reviewer comment as not applicable, trace through the actual source code to verify the claim — don't assume delegation without proof
Running the E2E test locally before committing catches issues that would otherwise require a full CI round-trip

friction: Multiple rounds of PR review resolution needed (3 separate /resolve-pr-reviews invocations) due to CodeRabbit adding new comments after each push
One outside-of-diff-range CodeRabbit review comment couldn't be resolved via the thread API — required a separate PR comment reply
VPS SSH timeout caused a false-alarm CI failure during the staging deploy, requiring manual health check before determining it was transient
Stale worktree from phase-20 branch was left behind after merge, requiring cleanup
